source.author: verg
source.text: Vix adeo aggnovit pavitantem et dira tegentem supplicia, et notis compellat vocibus ultro:
source.text_original: Vix adeo aggnovit pavitantem et dira tegentem / supplicia, et notis compellat vocibus ultro: /
source.text_english: Hardly did he recognize her, trembling and covering her dreadful sufferings, and he addresses her of his own accord with familiar words:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ut puer ad notas erectum Pelea voces vidit et ingenti tendentem bracchia passu, assiluit caraque diu cervice pependit.
reuse.text_original: ut puer ad notas erectum Pelea voces / vidit et ingenti tendentem bracchia passu, / assiluit caraque diu cervice pependit.
reuse.text_english: as the boy saw Peleus at the familiar voices, rising up, and stretching out his arms with a great stride, he sprang to him and long hung upon his dear neck.
